sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent infrastructure dominates today’s GitHub Trending page: Paperclip and Hindsight lead by a wide margin, while office automation, MCP, and inference optimization extend the same agent-centered wave. Established foundations such as TensorFlow, VS Code, LLVM, and Next.js remain present but show smaller daily gains.

sections.title: paperclipai/paperclip
sections.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work

sections.title: vectorize-io/hindsight
sections.why_notable: Agent memory is attracting unusually strong daily demand.

sections.title: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer
sections.description: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
sections.why_notable: Inference optimization is trending alongside agent software.

sections.title: dream-num/univer
sections.description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
sections.why_notable: AI is moving into structured office and productivity workflows.

sections.title: tensorflow/tensorflow
sections.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
sections.why_notable: A mature ML foundation still appears among today’s leaders.

sections.title: rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch
sections.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
sections.why_notable: Practical AI-engineering education is drawing substantial attention.

sections.title: openbao/openbao
sections.description: OpenBao is a software solution to manage, store, and distribute sensitive data including secrets, certificates, and keys.
sections.why_notable: Open-source secrets infrastructure provides the security counterweight to the AI-heavy list.

sections.title: block/buzz
sections.why_notable: Rust-powered collaboration infrastructure is a notable non-AI entrant.

sections.title: microsoft/vscode
sections.why_notable: The dominant developer editor remains a steady ecosystem anchor.

sections.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
sections.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients
sections.why_notable: Security research workflows are being packaged for AI coding clients.

sections.title: llvm/llvm-project
sections.description: The LLVM Project is a collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies.
sections.why_notable: Compiler infrastructure remains a durable systems foundation.

sections.title: anthropics/claude-code-action
sections.why_notable: The repository connects Claude Code capabilities to GitHub Actions automation.

sections.title: actions/runner-images
sections.why_notable: CI infrastructure remains visible despite lower daily star gains.

sections.title: mobile-next/mobile-mcp
sections.description: Model Context Protocol Server for Mobile Automation and Scraping (iOS, Android, Emulators, Simulators and Real Devices)
sections.why_notable: MCP is extending agent control into mobile automation and testing.

sections.title: vercel/next.js
sections.why_notable: A foundational web framework continues to receive steady attention.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content:
- **Agent platforms and memory:** paperclipai/paperclip and vectorize-io/hindsight occupy the top two positions, while anthropics/claude-code-action and zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill apply agents to automation and security workflows.
- **AI-native productivity and interfaces:** dream-num/univer targets office artifacts, and mobile-next/mobile-mcp brings MCP to mobile devices.
- **Inference and ML foundations:** NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer, tensorflow/tensorflow, and rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch cover optimization, core ML, and practical engineering.
- **Languages:** TypeScript leads the listed set (paperclip, univer, VS Code, Claude Code Action, mobile-mcp), followed by Python (Hindsight, Model-Optimizer, AI Engineering) and smaller Go, Rust, C++, LLVM, PowerShell, and JavaScript representation.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The clearest shift is from standalone model tooling toward agent operating layers: memory, workplace orchestration, structured-document execution, mobile control, and CI integration. Security and infrastructure projects remain part of the same movement, suggesting that deployment and governance concerns are rising alongside agent capability.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s list is less about a single model release than about the surrounding software stack needed to make AI agents useful. The strongest momentum is in orchestration, memory, productivity surfaces, and tool connectivity, while mature developer and ML foundations provide the base layer.
